name: Shocker

abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): E1 ve E2 kullanma — özel saldırıları otomatik bloklar. Koşarken engellenemez olur, dikkat et. E1 bazen engellenemez olup sersemletebilir.
signatureAbility:
Percussive Kickback
Whenever Shocker is Stunned or the Opponent gains a Prowess, gain 3 Vibro-Shock Charges.
Shocker's first Special Attack 1 in each fight costs [10 - 100]% less Power.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Shocker's custom padded suit grants him Immunity to Shock effects and Concussion Debuffs, and reduces the duration of incoming Stuns by 50%.
If the Opponent has the Limber Mastery active, it is removed.
Shocker cannot land Critical Hits, but all his attacks reduce the Opponent's Armor Rating by his Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Vibro-Shock Charges - Max: 100
content: Landing or being struck by a Light or Medium Attack grants 1 indefinite Vibro-Shock Charge.
At 50+ Vibro-Shock Charges, while Dashing forwards Shocker is Passively Unblockable. If this Dash Attack breaks the Opponent's Block, this effect goes on cooldown for 30 seconds.
If Shocker is struck while Unblockable, remove 50 Vibro-Shock Charges.

abilitySections.title: Auto-Block
content: At 50+ Vibro-Shock Charges, if Shocker would be struck by a Special Attack, consume 25 Charges to Auto-Block the rest of the attack.

abilitySections.title: Medium Attacks
content: +2% chance per Vibro-Shock Charge to Invalidate an Opponent's Prowess. Max: 100%.
+0.5% chance per Vibro-Shock Charge to inflict a Stun Debuff for 0.8 seconds. Max: 25%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Charging a Heavy Attack consumes a Vibro-Shock Charge every 0.05 seconds and can be charged until all Vibro-Shock Charges are consumed.
The final hit gains +[10,168] Attack Rating per Vibro-Shock Charge consumed. This scales with Base Attack but benefits from Class Advantage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: +1% chance per Vibro-Shock Charge to inflict a Stun Debuff for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
At 50+ Vibro-Shock Charges, this attack is Passively Unblockable.
At the end of this attack, gain 30 Vibro-Shock Charges.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a [1,178.57] Physical Vulnerability Passive and a Stun Passive for 5 seconds, plus 0.05 seconds per Vibro-Shock Charge.
These effects are not affected by Ability Accuracy and are removed once the Opponent is struck 3 times.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a 100% Energize Passive until the next time Shocker reaches 2 Bars of Power.
While this Energize is active, Vibro-Shock Charge max is increased to 150.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Percussive Kickback
content: Whenever Shocker is Stunned or the Opponent gains a Prowess, gain 3 Vibro-Shock Charges.
Shocker's first Special Attack 1 in each fight costs [10 - 100]% less Power.
